title: Mississauga: Niagara Falls Day Tour with Boat Cruise
includes: Local Maple Syrup, chocolate & fudge tasting
Round Trip Transportation from Central Mississauga
Niagara cruises Boat (May to Nov) or Skylon Tower (winter)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
May be operated by a multi-lingual guide
Vegetarian option is available, please advise at time of booking if required

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience Niagara Falls on this exciting 1 day luxury tour from Mississauga. Skip the lines and enjoy a Niagara Falls and Niagara Gorge district guided bus tour and a Niagara City Cruise boat cruise with ample time to explore the gems of Niagara Falls & Clifton Hill on your own or with family.This tour includes Central Mississauga pickup and drop off, Boat (addon), Whirlpool, Queenston Heights History Tour and a complimentary Maple Syrup.
